scope: Official-page promotion review, not live-media validation.

results.note: Official House proceedings portal linked to the House website and the upper-house service. Chromium returned HTTP 200 and displayed the current Diet term, a dated concurrent committee-broadcast schedule and searchable recordings. This is one portal covering chamber and committee events, not a separate permanent feed for each committee. Official-page source check only; active media was not validated.

Official Sangiin proceedings service cross-linked from the House of Representatives WebTV. Chromium returned HTTP 200 and displayed a meeting calendar, plenary and committee selection and archived meetings. IPU Parline records the English upper-house name as Senate from 23 July 2026; constitutional quotations may retain House of Councillors. No persistent HLS channel or active live media was validated. Official-page source check only; active media was not validated.

Official Parliament Mediathek. The institutional sitting guide documents live Nationalrat, Bundesrat and Bundesversammlung coverage. Chromium returned HTTP 200 and displayed dated sittings of both chambers. Keep one shared portal record until distinct recurring chamber or room player identities are validated. Official-page source check only; active media was not validated.

Official National Assembly broadcast portal. Chromium returned HTTP 200 and displayed dated chamber proceedings, including the 20 October 2026 sitting. Institutional notice pages cross-link Parliament TV; its help documents live main-chamber and archived coverage. The event guide may be empty between sittings; no always-on channel is inferred. Official-page source check only; active media was not validated.

Official lower-house WebTV linked to camera.it, distinct from the existing Senate record. Chromium returned HTTP 200 and displayed the current dated plenary, multiple committee events and a live-event section. The portal covers event players; no recurring raw HLS room identity has been validated. Official-page source check only; active media was not validated.

The official Assembly committee-broadcast introduction returned HTTP 200 in Chromium and links this current committee directory. The directory separately maps four standing and four current special committees to official YouTube channels and labels past special committees separately. Live and recorded coverage is explicitly documented. Catalogue the directory as one official viewing source; do not pretend committee channels are HLS or stable physical-room feeds. Official-page source check only; active media was not validated.

Official provincial Legislature VIVO portal, distinct from the Córdoba city council. Chromium returned HTTP 200 and loaded an institutional YouTube event embed with dated 2026 legislative sittings. A recording was present during review; active live playback and simultaneous committee coverage were not established. Official-page source check only; active media was not validated.

Official Assembly TV Alesc page and its institutional About page were opened through web retrieval; the live section and legislative broadcaster identity are explicit. This is an official-page viewing record with that access limitation, not validated direct playback or an always-on uptime claim. Official-page source check only; active media was not validated.
